name: Nak'tah

abilities.name: Coiled Lash
abilities.description: A basic ranged attack that does minor magic damage.

abilities.name: Quick Strike
abilities.description: A basic melee attack that does minor physical damage.

abilities.name: Summon Aura of Protection
abilities.description: The enemy summons an Aura of Protection totem that gives nearby allies increased resistance to damage. The totem can be destroyed in five hits from any source or one heavy attack. Destroying the totem will stun all enemies nearby.

abilities.name: Thundering Presence
abilities.description: Nak'Tah casts Thundering Presence on itself, gaining armor while dealing damage over time to nearby players.

abilities.name: Lightning Flood
abilities.description: Nak'Tah casts a Lightning Flood-like ability which deals Shock damage over time in the area.

abilities.name: Streak
abilities.description: Nak'Tah dashes forwards, dealing Shock damage and stunning targets in his wake.

abilities.name: Pöwer Overload heavy attack
abilities.description: Nak'tah sprays lightning in a large and wide cone in front of him, causing very high Shock damage.
